test_skip_op_basic: test the skip operation on a data pipeline to skip first N elements
test_skip_op_count_greater: test the skip operation when count exceeds the number of elements in the sequence
test_skip_op_zero_count: test the skip operation with zero count to verify all elements are returned
test_skip_op_state_save_restore: test the skip operation state saving and restoring using state_dict and load_state_dict
test_skip_op_reset: test the skip operation pipeline reset functionality to restart iteration from the beginning
